THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TAKAHARA, EMI MARTIN, LEAH RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HOME REALTY INVESTMENTS CITY HAULING SF, ( CORONADO SERVANDO ) $7,183.25 PRINCIPAL, $140.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,323.25, ANTONIO CASTELLUCCI DBA HOME REALTY INVESTMENT AND SERVANDO CORONADO DBA CITY HAULING SF SHALL PAY PLAINTIFFS $6,233.25 TO EMI TAKAHARA AND $950.00 TO LEAH MARTIN. SERVANDO CORONADO TESTIFIED THAT "CITY HAULING SF" IS HIS BUSINESS DBA. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
